captions_on_screen: headline text in the first seconds; burned-in white subtitle with dark outline for the closing line from 38 s; station signs in the scene are handwritten posters, not overlays
editing_rhythm: 24 shots, average 1.9 s; continuous voiceover; cuts follow the stations; vertical clips mixed with one pillarboxed clip (about 19-20 s)
ending_and_cta: Last 3 s: close-up of children drawing with markers and a yellow oil pastel, subtitle: 'תשמרו את הסרטון לחגיגה הבאה שלכם !'. Caption: 'שמרו את הפוסט לחגיגה הבאה שלכם'
convincing: Interpretation: a clear organising idea (five stations), specific details to copy, real children using the materials, credible mother-and-professional framing
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: product mentions are wide ('Giotto materials') and no price or where to buy; many fast cuts; disclosure is only in the caption
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: 'what X looks like when mum is a Y' is a good hook pattern; a numbered walkthrough ('5 stations') is easy to follow. LumeBook can use the same shape for a reading-corner or birthday-gift setup filmed on a phone, with a 'save for your next celebration' CTA
solo_without_child: partly, the yard and product flat-lays can be filmed alone; the proof shots need children
not_verified: Whether the party was the creator's own; whether the pillarboxed clip (about 19-20 s) is a stock clip; exact product names for all items (several partly legible); the clay and beads brands
brand: Giotto (Make Up, Olio Maxi, Acquerelli, Turbo Maxi Fluo, Pongo); Giotto Israel tagged in caption
